description.value: The Grasshopper Pub and Restaurant is part of the family-owned Pender Harbour Hotel complex on the Sunshine Coast, with patios offering views overlooking Madeira Park. The broader site includes a hotel, a liquor store stocked with cold beer, wine, and spirits, and a marina dock serving boaters and road travellers alike. Touring cyclists on the Sunshine Coast Highway will find it a well-rounded stop for pub fare and a drink in a scenic harbour setting.
